rules.diagnosis_template: The structural cohesion of the {module_name} module is very low (SCPM: {scpm:.2f}). Methods share almost no data structures. The module has {n_components} disconnected groups of methods.
rules.recommendation_template: Split the {module_name} module into {n_components} separate modules, one for each disconnected group. Each group represents a cohesive unit that should be in its own file.

rules.diagnosis_template: The structural cohesion of the {module_name} module is very low (SCPM: {scpm:.2f}). Methods share almost no data structures or common state.
rules.recommendation_template: The {module_name} module should be refactored. Consider: 1) Pass data explicitly as parameters instead of relying on implicit sharing, 2) Extract shared data into a class with methods operating on instance variables (self.x), 3) Use module-level global variables for shared configuration/datasets.
